author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
FromSoftware has followed up their massively succesful soulslike, Elden Ring, with two multiplayer-focused projects: Elden Ring Nightreign and the upcoming The Duskbloods. But FromSoftware president Hidetaka Miyazaki is reassuring fans that the company is not pivoting to solely PvP titles, it just so happened that development on to multiplayer games happened to progress simultaneously. In other news, 007 First Light has already moved 4 million copies in three months, and that's before the Nintendo Switch 2 version has even been released. And finally, it's more bad news for the "No Disc No Buy" supporters, as more data shows July to have been the worst month ever for physical game media sales.

#TheDuskbloods #Gaming #IGN
title: FromSoftware Reassures Fans More Single-Player Games Are Coming - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Battlefield 6’s first major collab is designed for those who feel the need for speed. This is what you need to know about the Top Gun-themed event coming to Battlefield on August 18th.

Jump into two Limited-Time Game Modes: Carrier Strike and Fighter Sweep. 

Use the brand new jets to your advantage, including the F/A-81F Super Spectre lets you soar across the battle in this 2-seat jet featured in Top Gun and dominate every dogfight whilst striking enemies from above. 

Next, the F-74 Seacat is a twin-seater Top Gun fighter jet equipped with swing-wings, adapting the aircraft for every flight and every fight. 

On top of all that, you can jump back into the iconic Wake Island map, faithful to the original, with new updates like fortifications on the map, destroyable bridges, and an aircraft carrier. 

Presented by Battlefield.
title: Battlefield 6 Top Gun Event Breakdown: New Game Modes!

description:
Check out the trailer for Golden Axe, an upcoming animated series based on the classic arcade game. Golden Axe features the voice talents of Matthew Rhys as Gilius Thunderhead, a grumpy battle dwarf with exceptionally poor hygiene and a chip on his shoulder; Danny Pudi as Hampton Squib, a naive, inexperienced first time adventurer who has dreamt of questing his entire life; Lisa Gilroy as Tyris Flare, a fearsome battle sorceress, deadly in a fight and even deadlier with her sharp wit; Liam McIntyre as Ax Battler, a barbarian warrior with a strict code of honor and sweet golden retriever demeanor; and Carl Tart as Chronos “Evil” Lait, an uncomfortably cheesy humanoid panther. 

In a hilarious homage to SEGA’s iconic 1989 video game, Golden Axe follows legendary warriors Ax Battler, Tyris Flare and Gilius Thunderhead as they reunite to save Yuria from the evil giant Death Adder, who just won’t seem to stay dead. author: IGN
description:
Co-op is coming to God Save Birmingham when it arrives in Early Access. Watch the latest God Save Birmingham trailer for this upcoming brutal medieval zombie survival game set in 14th-century Birmingham, England. The new trailer showcases co-op gameplay as you face zombies and work together with friends to survive. God Save Birmingham will be available in Steam Early Access, with console releases to follow.

In God Save Birmingham, as the lone survivor in a city overrun by the dead, you’ll rely on your wits, your fists, and whatever you can arm yourself with to endure the nightmare.

Explore a painstakingly recreated medieval town where danger lurks around every corner — not just from the undead, but from hunger, thirst, exhaustion, and even trip hazards. Grapple with gritty, real world physics in a world where every step could be your last.

Outsmart the horde, or become their next meal.
title: God Save Birmingham - Official Co-Op Reveal Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Tony, from A24 and director Matt Johnson, is a unique kind of biography. Adapting just a small section of the Anthony Bourdain memoir, Kitchen Confidential, the biopic starring Dominic Sessa and Antonio Banderas focuses on a very small slice of the late chef's very big life. Leaning towards biographical fan fiction, not all of the details are strictly accurate, but the film conveys the spirit of a man who would become famous. 

Siddhant Adlakha reviews, and then sticks around to talk with IGN's Clint Gage about surface level, birth-to-death biopics, the creative liberties in telling this story and the gobs of reviews he's written for IGN over the years.

#IGN
title: Tony Review
